places.name: Red River
places.note: July and Joe ford the boggy river where deer cross, then rope out a bug-studying traveler stuck midstream who had been tossing his gear into the water.
places.location_hint: reached after several days riding southwest from Fort Smith through rainy pine woods; broad and muddy, curving down from the north

places.name: Texas
places.note: July and Joe reach its edge on the south bank of the Red; Sedgwick plans to preach the Gospel there.
places.location_hint: south bank of the Red River

places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: July fights a nagging worry about Elmira that tempts him to turn back there.

places.name: Little Rock
places.note: Sedgwick says he left about a thousand insect specimens there.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: July and Joe push hard southwest through dripping, mosquito-ridden pine woods, asking farmers about Jake, who had stayed with some.
places.location_hint: pine woods between Fort Smith and the Red River

groups.label: July Johnson and Joe
groups.hint: just across to the south (Texas) bank of the Red River

groups.label: Sedgwick
groups.hint: walking down the south bank of the Red, headed into Texas
